reason: Named lab with the batch report on the page and a QR code is exactly what I look for before buying a supplement. 200 mg bisglycinate with no oxide is a real dose, and the empty-box guarantee makes one box a low-risk try at $24.99.
objection: 30 foil sachets a month is a lot of packaging waste, and I want to open the actual lab report and check the batch number before I trust it. Made in China makes me want to see that report even more.
